Title: Member registration
User Story / Requirement: As a member, I want to create an account with my university email so that my meal responses are tied to me.
Acceptance Criteria: Registration requires a valid email and password | Email must be verified before the account is active | Duplicate emails are rejected

Title: Login, logout and password reset
User Story / Requirement: As a user, I want to log in, log out and reset a forgotten password so that I can access my account securely.
Acceptance Criteria: Valid credentials start a session; invalid ones show a generic error | Password reset link is emailed and expires after 1 hour | Logout ends the session on that device

Title: Role-based access
User Story / Requirement: As a chapter admin, I want users assigned roles (Member, Kitchen Staff, House Director, Chapter Admin) so that each person sees only what they need.
Acceptance Criteria: Each user has exactly one role per chapter | Permissions are enforced on the server, not only hidden in the UI | Only Chapter Admins can change roles

Title: Chapter setup and join code
User Story / Requirement: As a chapter admin, I want to create my house and invite members with a join code so that onboarding a whole chapter is fast.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin can create a chapter with name, address and timezone | A join code is generated and can be regenerated | Members who join with the code are pending until approved

Title: Roster management
User Story / Requirement: As a chapter admin, I want to approve, remove and label members as live-in or live-out so that the roster matches who actually eats at the house.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin can approve or reject pending members | Admin can deactivate a member without deleting history | Each member is labeled live-in or live-out

Title: Meal plan types
User Story / Requirement: As a house director, I want to assign each member a meal plan (e.g., full, lunch-only, none) so that only eligible members appear in each meal's count.
Acceptance Criteria: Plans define which meals a member is eligible for | Ineligible members cannot sign in to those meals | Changing a plan affects future meals only

Title: Recurring meal schedule
User Story / Requirement: As a house director, I want to define the weekly meal schedule with serve times and a sign-out cutoff for each meal so that members know the deadlines.
Acceptance Criteria: Each meal has a name, days of week, serve time and cutoff | Meals are generated for the semester from the template | Cutoff is stored in the chapter's timezone

Title: Schedule exceptions
User Story / Requirement: As a house director, I want to cancel or add individual meals for holidays, breaks and chapter events so that the schedule reflects reality.
Acceptance Criteria: A single meal or a date range can be cancelled | One-off meals can be added | Cancelled meals are hidden from members and excluded from reports

Title: Post menu
User Story / Requirement: As kitchen staff, I want to post the menu for each meal so that members can decide whether to eat.
Acceptance Criteria: Staff can add or edit menu text per meal | Menu changes after posting are timestamped

Title: View upcoming meals
User Story / Requirement: As a member, I want to see the upcoming meals, their cutoffs and my current status so that I don't miss a deadline.
Acceptance Criteria: Shows at least the next 7 days of meals | Each meal shows serve time, cutoff, my status and menu if posted

Title: Default attendance mode
User Story / Requirement: As a house director, I want to choose whether members are counted in or out by default so that the system matches how my house already works.
Acceptance Criteria: Chapter setting: default-in (sign out to skip) or default-out (sign in to eat) | Default applies to every eligible member for every generated meal | Changing the mode affects future meals only

Title: Sign in / sign out of a meal
User Story / Requirement: As a member, I want to change my status for a meal in two taps or fewer so that responding is effortless.
Acceptance Criteria: Status toggles from the meal list without opening another page | Change is reflected in the live headcount within 5 seconds | Confirmation is shown to the member

Title: Cutoff enforcement
User Story / Requirement: As kitchen staff, I want changes locked after the cutoff so that the count I cook for doesn't move.
Acceptance Criteria: Members cannot change status after cutoff | Staff and House Director can still override with a note | UI shows a countdown to cutoff

Title: Standing weekly preferences
User Story / Requirement: As a member, I want to set recurring preferences (e.g., always out for Friday dinner) so that I don't have to respond every week.
Acceptance Criteria: Member can set a preference per meal slot | Preferences apply to newly generated meals | One-off changes override the standing preference

Title: Bulk sign-out for a date range
User Story / Requirement: As a member, I want to sign out of every meal between two dates so that I can handle trips and breaks at once.
Acceptance Criteria: Member picks a start and end date | All eligible meals in range are set to out | Meals past cutoff are not changed

Title: Guests
User Story / Requirement: As a member, I want to add guests to a meal so that the kitchen accounts for visitors.
Acceptance Criteria: Member can add 1-3 guests per meal before cutoff | Guests are shown separately in the headcount | House Director can disable guests

Title: Attendance change log
User Story / Requirement: As a house director, I want a log of who changed what and when so that disputes can be resolved.
Acceptance Criteria: Every status change records user, old value, new value and timestamp | Log is read-only and filterable by member and meal

Title: Request a late plate
User Story / Requirement: As a member, I want to request a late plate before the cutoff with a pickup note so that I can eat when class runs late.
Acceptance Criteria: Request available only before cutoff | Optional note (e.g., pickup time, no onions) | Requesting a late plate counts the member as eating

Title: Late plate list and labels
User Story / Requirement: As kitchen staff, I want a list of late plates with printable name labels so that I can package them without texts.
Acceptance Criteria: List shows name, note and dietary flags | Labels print on a standard sheet

Title: Late plate pickup tracking
User Story / Requirement: As kitchen staff, I want to mark late plates picked up or not so that we can track waste from uncollected plates.
Acceptance Criteria: Each late plate can be marked picked up / not picked up | Uncollected late plates feed waste reports

Title: Live headcount
User Story / Requirement: As kitchen staff, I want a live count of who is eating each meal so that I know how much to prepare.
Acceptance Criteria: Shows total in, total out, guests and late plates | Updates without a page refresh | Shows today's meals first

Title: Final count at cutoff
User Story / Requirement: As kitchen staff, I want the count frozen at cutoff with a timestamp so that I have a reliable number to cook to.
Acceptance Criteria: Final count is saved when cutoff passes | Later overrides are shown as adjustments, not silent changes

Title: Kitchen tablet view
User Story / Requirement: As kitchen staff, I want a large, glanceable view for a kitchen tablet so that I can check the count while cooking.
Acceptance Criteria: Large-type layout readable from about 2 meters | Stays awake / auto-refreshes during meal windows

Title: Manual count adjustment
User Story / Requirement: As kitchen staff, I want to record walk-ins and the number actually served so that the data reflects reality.
Acceptance Criteria: Staff enter actual served count after the meal | Adjustments require a short reason

Title: Dietary profile
User Story / Requirement: As a member, I want to record my dietary restrictions and allergies once so that the kitchen always knows.
Acceptance Criteria: Choose from a standard list (vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, nut allergy, etc.) plus free text | Member can edit or clear the profile at any time

Title: Dietary breakdown on headcount
User Story / Requirement: As kitchen staff, I want each meal's count broken down by restriction so that I prepare the right number of alternate plates.
Acceptance Criteria: Shows counts per restriction for members marked in | Severe allergies are visually highlighted

Title: Allergy flags on late plate labels
User Story / Requirement: As kitchen staff, I want allergy flags printed on late plate labels so that a plate never goes to the wrong person.
Acceptance Criteria: Labels include allergy icons/text for that member

Title: Dietary data visibility
User Story / Requirement: As a member, I want my dietary and allergy information visible only to kitchen staff and the house director so that my health information stays private.
Acceptance Criteria: Other members cannot see dietary data | Access is enforced server-side by role

Title: Cutoff reminders
User Story / Requirement: As a member, I want a reminder before cutoff so that I remember to update my status.
Acceptance Criteria: Reminder sent a configurable time before cutoff (default 2 hours) | Delivered by push or email

Title: Meal change alerts
User Story / Requirement: As a member, I want to be notified when a meal is cancelled or the menu changes so that I can adjust my plans.
Acceptance Criteria: Cancellation alerts go to everyone signed in to that meal | Menu change alerts are opt-in

Title: Notification preferences
User Story / Requirement: As a member, I want to control which notifications I get and how so that the app isn't annoying.
Acceptance Criteria: Per-type on/off toggles | Choose push, email or both

Title: Store attendance actuals
User Story / Requirement: As a house director, I want every meal's final count, adjustments and actual served stored so that we can analyze attendance over time.
Acceptance Criteria: One record per meal with final count, adjustments, served count and late plates | Data retained for at least 2 academic years

Title: Calendar event tags
User Story / Requirement: As a house director, I want to tag dates (exam week, home game, break, chapter event) so that forecasts account for unusual days.
Acceptance Criteria: Tags apply to a date or date range | Tags are visible on the meal schedule

Title: Baseline turnout forecast
User Story / Requirement: As kitchen staff, I want a predicted turnout for upcoming meals based on history so that I can plan before members respond.
Acceptance Criteria: Forecast uses a moving average by meal and day of week | Shown beside the live count for meals in the next 7 days | Hidden until at least 3 weeks of data exist

Title: Event-adjusted forecast
User Story / Requirement: As kitchen staff, I want forecasts adjusted for exam weeks, game days and breaks so that predictions stay accurate on unusual days.
Acceptance Criteria: Forecast applies a learned adjustment factor per tag | Shows which tags influenced the prediction

Title: Forecast accuracy report
User Story / Requirement: As a house director, I want to compare forecast vs. actual so that I know whether to trust the predictions.
Acceptance Criteria: Shows forecast, actual and error for each past meal | Reports mean absolute error per meal type

Title: Attendance and waste reports
User Story / Requirement: As a house director, I want reports on no-show rates, late plate pickup and attendance trends, exportable to CSV, so that I can reduce waste and justify budget decisions.
Acceptance Criteria: Filter by date range and meal | Includes no-show rate (counted in but not served) | Export to CSV

Title: Portion and ingredient suggestions
User Story / Requirement: As kitchen staff, I want ingredient quantities suggested from the forecast and recipe yields so that ordering is less guesswork.
Acceptance Criteria: Recipes store yield per serving | Suggested quantities scale with the forecast

Title: Food cost tracking
User Story / Requirement: As a chapter treasurer, I want cost per meal and per member tracked so that the chapter can see the money saved by reducing waste.
Acceptance Criteria: Staff enter grocery spend per week | Reports cost per meal served

Title: Mobile-first responsive UI
User Story / Requirement: The member interface shall be fully usable on phone screens 360px wide and up.
Acceptance Criteria: All member flows work at 360px width without horizontal scrolling

Title: Response time
User Story / Requirement: Sign-in/out actions shall complete in under 1 second at the 95th percentile for a chapter of 150 members.
Acceptance Criteria: Load test with 150 concurrent users meets the target

Title: Security baseline
User Story / Requirement: The system shall hash passwords, use HTTPS everywhere and enforce role permissions server-side.
Acceptance Criteria: Passwords hashed with a modern algorithm (bcrypt/argon2) | No endpoint returns data outside the user's role

Title: Health data privacy
User Story / Requirement: Dietary and allergy data shall be collected minimally, visible only to authorized roles and deletable by the member.
Acceptance Criteria: Member can delete their dietary profile | Access to dietary data is logged

Title: Timezone correctness
User Story / Requirement: All schedules and cutoffs shall be evaluated in the chapter's local timezone, including daylight saving changes.
Acceptance Criteria: Cutoffs fire correctly across a DST transition in tests

Title: Headcount consistency
User Story / Requirement: Concurrent status changes near the cutoff shall never produce an incorrect final count.
Acceptance Criteria: Simultaneous updates are serialized or transactional | Final count equals the sum of stored statuses

Title: Availability during meal windows
User Story / Requirement: The system shall be available 99% of the time during meal windows.
Acceptance Criteria: Uptime monitoring and alerting in place

Title: Accessibility
User Story / Requirement: The UI shall meet WCAG 2.1 AA.
Acceptance Criteria: Passes automated accessibility checks | Fully usable with keyboard and screen reader

Title: Multi-chapter data isolation
User Story / Requirement: Data for each chapter shall be isolated so that houses never see each other's data.
Acceptance Criteria: Every query is scoped by chapter | Automated tests verify cross-chapter access is denied
